scenes.title: Sela's offer at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver and offers a dawn departure. She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang, forty years ago, and recounts her grandmother's claim that the water rose warm.

scenes.title: The hymn page in Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party finds warm black floodwater and hymn-book pages, including one marked "M. Brand" that Teo identifies as Mira's handwriting. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement; Oren takes damage from the air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell at the drowned chapel
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, louder humming accompanies pale figures in rows, and the GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: A dawn dive planned at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: The party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party completes a long rest.
